info.name: Verifiable API Documentation Alerts ProviderEnrollments API

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the group to get enrollments for.

params.name: providerId
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered on enrollments with the specified provider.

params.name: payerPlanId
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered on enrollments with the specified payer plan.

params.name: networkStatus
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered on enrollments with the specified network status.

params.name: enrollmentStatus
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered on enrollments with the specified enrollment status.

params.name: specialistType
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered on enrollments with the specified specialist type.

params.name: sort
params.description: If set, the properties and directions the returned data will be sorted by.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the page to start.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to render the page requested. To load the first page send an empty cursor, then the system will generate the cursors to go to the next and/or previous pages automatically.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of items to include in a single page.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction the returned data will be sorted by.

items.docs: Returns a page of provider enrollments.
Creates a new enrollment of provider to payer plan.

items.docs: Returns the data for a specific provider enrollment.

params.name: providerEnrollmentId
params.description: Identifier of the provider enrollment to patch.

items.docs: Allows you to change a provider enrollment's data properties.
